response.original_title: ((Faqs-Guide)) How to communicate on Virgin Voyages Cruise?
response.overview: To communicate on a Virgin Voyages Cruise, +1-866-829-1280(US) or +44-204-586-5316(UK) use the complimentary chat feature on the Virgin Voyages Cruise app. Once onboard, +1-866-829-1280 connect your device to the ship's Wi-Fi (MedallionNet), put your phone on airplane mode, and you can message your travel companions for free without purchasing an internet package. The primary way to communicate onboard a Virgin Voyages Cruise ship is by using +1-866-829-1280 the free internal chat feature inside the Official Virgin Voyages Cruise App. This feature allows you to message members of your travel group without purchasing a paid internet package. Communicating on a Virgin Voyages Cruise is easiest using the free Virgin Voyages Cruise app, +1-866 829-1280(US) which works on the ship’s internal network without requiring an expensive internet package. Stateroom Phones: You can call directly +1-866 829-1280(US) between stateroom phones by dialing the cabin number.
